face_to_path_deg.points_at: A miss that repeats at about the same size every swing. Whatever produces it is the same every time, which points at something already set before the swing starts rather than at something that happens during it. None of that is visible here, so the test is empirical: change one thing at setup, hit another set, and see whether the center moves.

provenance.note: 18 tracked shots on hd_golf, fundamentals: 12 with a 7i, each also filmed face-on and carrying two pose rows (head_sway_norm about 0.2 against its 0 +/- 0.06, and finish_balance_norm about 0.1 against 0 +/- 0.024), and 6 with a driver. A drill hit on 2026-09-04 is in the corpus' excluded list as untracked, so it is in no count; the corpus had already left it out. The 7i's numbers are cut to establish one of each: face-to-path about +4.0 with a small spread (a bias), carries from 132 to 170 (scatter), and a start line within 0.3 degrees of 0 (a strength, as is its offline). Both pose rows establish a bias in the 7i's dispersion too, and neither reaches the list (Decision 12), and no grade reads them. The driver has 6 shots, so its spread is withheld and its mean's interval straddles the tolerance: nothing is established, and its list is empty rather than a strength. Working. driver consistency: 6 judged; typical carry 249.0 yd and start-line offline 0.03054287424430857 yd, the medians of the 6 non-mishit judged shots; window 24.900000000000002 yd; consistent 6, missed none. driver consistency grade withheld (6 of the 10 it needs). driver blend absent (nothing graded). 7i consistency: 12 judged; typical carry 150.0 yd and start-line offline 0.0 yd, the medians of the 12 non-mishit judged shots; window 15.0 yd; consistent 9, missed 2026-09-01/4 (carry 168.0, offline 0.000), 2026-09-02/1 (carry 132.0, offline -0.230), 2026-09-02/4 (carry 170.0, offline 0.297). 7i consistency grade 9/12 = 0.75, Wilson [0.4677, 0.9111]. 7i blend 0.75, averaging ['consistency'] and excluding []. player consistency: pooled over driver + 7i, 18 judged, grade 15/18 = 0.8333333333333334, Wilson [0.6078, 0.9416]. player blend 0.8333333333333334, averaging ['consistency'] and excluding []. driver list: empty, nothing established either way. 7i list: scatter on carry_distance_yds at 2.7555; bias on face_to_path_deg at 2.0000; strength on start_line_offline_yds at 0.0942; strength on start_line_deg at 0.1578. player list: strength on start_line_deg at 0.6894.
provenance.source: worked by hand in M37 P5, against the M37 plan's decisions 1-8 and calls 2-12 and its P1-P4 findings, before P6-P9 build the code that must meet it. The grades, shares, Wilson intervals (z = 1.959963984540054, each bound clamped to the share and to [0, 1]), the medians, the grid, heel/toe's counts, the blends and the list's kinds, order and ratios are the hand's. Three kinds of number are carried rather than worked, each from the Rust function the plan says P6-P9 read it from, and gated elsewhere: strike.ball_speed and strike.dispersion, and the dispersion each list is ranked from, are analysis::club_profile::build_bag_profile's per club and analysis::dispersion::build_dispersion's over the whole corpus for the player (the career family gates both); heel/toe's mean_offset_mm and its interval are analysis::stats' mean_and_sd and mean_ci over the listed offsets. The corpus is hand-built as crates/storage::read_corpus writes one: each shot a whole ShotData, each launch_monitor row shot_measure's over the analysed view, and each flight or pose row a hand stand-in (detail 'hand'). The rules as worked: a club's topic exists when its every input is printed on one of the club's shots (capability::printed_on), low point only for an iron, wedge or hybrid, and a shape only when one of the club's shots declared it (call 7); its judged shots count toward metrics, are not shot_needs_review, and hold the inputs in the analysed view, and one whose input is printed on it and blank is unscored under its shot_unscored reason, else printed_blank (call 8); the player pools each topic over the clubs it exists for, and over the untagged shots for strike location and the shapes (call 9); a blend is the left-to-right sum of its graded shares in topic order over their count (call 11). The list (call 12) reads each club's ClubProfile.dispersion, and for the player the whole corpus' kept to club-independent metrics, over launch_monitor rows only: a weakness is an established bias, ratio |offset| / tolerance, or scatter, ratio sd / tolerance, largest first, ties in METRIC_TARGETS order and bias before scatter; a strength is a metric with a target whose center_ci lies inside target +/- tolerance (inclusive) and whose sd_ci.high is below the tolerance (strict), ratio max(|center_ci end - target|, sd_ci.high) / tolerance, smallest first, after every weakness
